title: Remove opum-workflow's content now that opum-fleet has proven resolution
summary: opum-fleet proved private federated resolution: opum-workflow@opum-fleet installed with gitCommitSha a0bec17 (verified independently in installed_plugins.json, not taken on their word), matching their reported HEAD. Clear to complete the handoff on this side. Removes opum-workflow's entire content tree (plugin.json, skills/opum-sdlc, skills/opum-handoff, hooks/, agents/, evals/, CHANGELOG.md) and the CI machinery that only existed to test it: scripts/check-evals.mjs, scripts/run-eval.sh, scripts/check-changelog-fold.mjs (and its orphaned test -- check-federated-pins.mjs and ITS test stay, they validate opum-lore/opum-quest's live pins independent of opum-workflow entirely), and three ci.yml jobs (check . eval structure, check . hook tests, check . plugin eval) that ran scripts/binaries now gone. The manifest job's own 'Manifests are valid JSON' step drops its plugin.json cross-check (there is no more owned plugin.json to check against); its 'plugin content changed means version moved' step is removed outright -- that whole mechanism (OPAG-65/OMARK-17) existed to guard opum-workflow's own version discipline, which no longer exists once opum-workflow doesn't live here. main's require-ci-on-main ruleset drops the two removed job names from required checks in the same change, so main is never left requiring a check that will never report again.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every file/directory that was opum-workflow's own content is removed: .claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/opum-sdlc/, skills/opum-handoff/, hooks/, agents/, evals/, CHANGELOG.md, scripts/check-evals.mjs, scripts/run-eval.sh, scripts/check-changelog-fold.mjs, scripts/test/check-changelog-fold.test.mjs. scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and scripts/test/check-federated-pins.test.mjs are explicitly NOT removed -- they validate opum-lore/opum-quest, independent of opum-workflow.
marketplace.json lists only opum-lore and opum-quest; opum-workflow's entry is gone, not just edited.

ci.yml no longer has the structure, hooks, or eval jobs, or the workflow_dispatch run_eval input that only drove the eval job. The manifest job's plugin.json cross-check and version-vs-CHANGELOG step are removed; its federated-pin-live-check step is untouched.

main's require-ci-on-main ruleset (id 22669384) required_status_checks no longer names check . eval structure or check . hook tests -- updated via gh api in the same change, verified by re-reading the ruleset afterward, not assumed to have taken effect.
README.md no longer claims opum-workflow lives here or instructs installing it from this marketplace -- corrected for accuracy in this same change rather than left stale pending a later polish pass.
CLAUDE.md's operating block and repository profile are NOT touched by this task -- that is OPAG-70's separate, later work, sequenced after this content departure per opum-agent's explicit ordering.

implementationNotes: Verified locally before committing: manifests logic reports 'manifests OK (2 plugin(s): opum-lore, opum-quest)', check-federated-pins.test.mjs 5/5, live check-federated-pins.mjs 'federated pins OK (2 plugin(s) checked)'. ci.yml is valid YAML (PyYAML's on:-as-boolean-key parse quirk confirmed harmless, not an actual defect) with exactly jobs: manifest, operating-block remaining. Ruleset updated via gh api PUT BEFORE this lands (not after) -- required_status_checks now names only check . manifests and check . operating block digest, verified by a fresh read, not assumed from the PUT response alone. Also cleaned up evals/results/ (4.6MB, gitignored, never tracked, now genuinely orphaned) as local housekeeping -- not a repo change.

Caught by CI itself, not by my own inventory: a second, previously-unnoticed workflow file, .github/workflows/hooks.yml, also tests hooks/ content (its own 'check . hooks' job, distinct from ci.yml's now-removed 'check . hook tests') -- a pre-existing duplicate from an old OPAG-45 branch merge that was apparently never folded into ci.yml as its own header comment says it should have been. Its PR run failed once hooks/ was deleted (script genuinely gone), correctly if uselessly. Not a required check on main (confirmed via the ruleset read above), so it never blocked anything, but a known-red, now-meaningless check is still a defect. Removed the whole file in this same change rather than leaving it red -- worth a note that I only ever inspected ci.yml directly all day; a full `ls .github/workflows/` would have caught this the first time hooks/ was touched, not the last.
finalSummary: opum-workflow's entire content tree removed, marketplace.json down to opum-lore/opum-quest, ci.yml trimmed to manifest+operating-block jobs, main's ruleset updated first, README rewritten for accuracy. CLAUDE.md untouched, per instruction -- that's OPAG-70 steps 1-3, separate work.
